SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, first_fiscal_week, last_fiscal_week, fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9
ORDER BY 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.*, c.ctrl_net, m.web_net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2

WITH wl AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, p.category, o.status, o.dispatch_ts_utc, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
)
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS odd_status
FROM wl
